feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 3 August 2026 12:22pm
items.description:
##Today##

Mostly dry day with bright or sunny intervals but turning cloudy later, then periods of rain developing overnight, perhaps heavy and thundery in places.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 21°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10, risk of 15-20


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

E


##Wind##

E or NE 15-20 gusting 20-25 at first, decreasing 10-15 in the afternoon, then veering E or SE 15-20 occasionally 20-25 in places overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain especially later. Hill fog increasing later.


##Comments##

Strong wind in places at first.


##Tomorrow##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain at first, possibly heavy in places, clearing to isolated showers, with brighter spells in the afternoon.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

14


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

E or SE 10-15 occasionally 20 in places at first, veering S or SW through the morning, increasing 15-20 in the evening, veering W overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Wednesday, 5 August 2026##

Isolated showers at first, soon becoming dry with sunny intervals developing. Rain overnight.

##Visibility##

##Comments##

Strong wind developing.
